question:
It might be simple question and I'm new to DBT.

I have one.sql file in DBT and it is inserting data into table TARGET.

I want to update table TARGET based on SORUCE table as below condition. I tried to place another sql file second.sql and it is not updating.

How to convert below sql into DBT model. Can you please help.

UPDATE TARGET S
SET S.FLAG='N'
FROM SOURCE T
WHERE S.FLAG='Y' AND S.ID=T.ID
title: DBT (Data Build Tool)-Update Syntax in dbt model
answer:
dbt model files, like the one.sql you're describing should contain the SELECT statement to make the TARGET table. The statement should always produce the correct table(or other materialization) when the model file is run. UPDATE statements are not needed.

When the SOURCE(s) that one.sql depends on are changed then the one.sql file should be run again to update the values in it. How it knows to run depends on a number of things outside the scope of this question. Whether the underlying database code does a DROP and re-CREATE table, incrementalism, or something else depends on the materialization: set for the model.

To be clear, dbt doesn't support running UPDATE statements. They're not supported on purpose. They're anti-antithetical to what dbt is trying to enable, such as lineage and accuracy.
